rationale: Chris brings CTO-level expertise in robotics simulation and a strong typescript/python/rust stack, while Aditya is actively deploying intelligent control models on resource-constrained microcontrollers—combining simulation knowledge with real-world edge AI implementation. Aditya's work in embedded systems, reinforcement learning, and prosthetics aligns directly with the robotics domain Chris leads at Zhavia Labs, and he's explicitly open to connecting on embedded AI and edge computing challenges where Chris's simulation background could be valuable.
intro_message: Chris Orlin Cardoza, meet Aditya bangde — Aditya's deploying RL and computer vision on edge devices for robotics and prosthetics, and your robotics simulation expertise at Zhavia Labs could be a natural fit for his work on intelligent control on microcontrollers.
